prompt: Compose a brief letter declining a job offer you have been considering.
response:
Subject: Thanks, but no thanks!

Hi [Name],

Thanks so much for offering me the job! I really appreciate it.

I was actually really excited about it at first, but I just realized I can't take it. I got another offer that's a little closer to where I'm at right now. Thanks for thinking of me though!

Hope you find someone great.

Best,
[Your Name]
